import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text, _split_text, split_graphemes, cell_len
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style


def test_split_text_at_column_zero():
    """Test that splitting at column zero returns empty left and whole text on right."""
    text = "Hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "Hello"


def test_split_text_at_column_zero_with_mixed_width():
    """Test split at column zero with mixed single and double-cell characters."""
    text = "Hello世界"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "Hello世界"


def test_split_text_at_column_zero_single_cell_text():
    """Test split at column zero with only single-cell characters (fast path)."""
    text = "abc"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "abc"


def test_split_text_at_column_zero_empty_string():
    """Test split at column zero on empty string."""
    text = ""
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == ""

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text


def test_split_text_double_cell_character():
    """Test that splitting inside a double-cell character replaces it with spaces."""
    # Chinese characters are typically double-width
    text = "A世界"
    # Position 1 is inside the double-width character
    left, right = split_text(text, 1)
    # When cutting in middle of 2-cell char, it becomes two spaces
    assert left == "A "
    assert right == " 界"


def test_split_text_multiple_double_cell():
    """Test with multiple double-cell characters."""
    text = "世界"  # Both are double-width (2 cells each)
    # Split at position 1 (middle of first character)
    left, right = split_text(text, 1)
    assert left == " "
    assert right == " 界"
    
    # Split at position 2 (between characters)
    left, right = split_text(text, 2)
    assert left == "世"
    assert right == "界"

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text


def test_split_text_mixed_single_and_double_cells():
    """Test splitting text that mixes single-cell and double-cell characters."""
    text = "aB世界c"
    
    # Split before double-width section
    left, right = split_text(text, 2)
    assert left == "aB"
    assert right == "世界c"
    
    # Split inside first double-width character
    left, right = split_text(text, 3)
    assert left == "aB "
    assert right == " 界c"
    
    # Split between characters
    left, right = split_text(text, 4)
    assert left == "aB世"
    assert right == "界c"


def test_split_text_zero_in_mixed():
    """Test splitting at zero with mixed character widths."""
    text = "a世b界c"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "a世b界c"

import pytest
from rich.segment import Segment

    """Test that Segment.split_cells at column 0 returns empty left and whole right."""

    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "Hello"


def test_segment_split_cells_at_zero_with_style():
    """Test split_cells at column 0 preserves style."""
    text = "Hello"
    style = Style(bold=True)
    segment = Segment(text, style)
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert left.style == style
    assert right.text == "Hello"
    assert right.style == style


def test_segment_split_cells_at_zero_empty():
    """Test split_cells at column 0 with empty segment."""
    segment = Segment("", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == ""

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_graphemes


def test_split_graphemes_basic():
    """Test that split_graphemes works with basic text."""
    text = "Hello"
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 5
    assert total_width == 5
    
    # Each character should have cell width 1
    for span in spans:
        assert span[2] == 1


def test_split_graphemes_mixed_width():
    """Test split_graphemes with mixed width characters."""
    text = "A世"
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 2
    # First character (single-width) + second character (double-width)
    assert total_width == 3


def test_split_graphemes_empty():
    """Test split_graphemes with empty string."""
    text = ""
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 0
    assert total_width == 0
